# rixl_project (Resource)

Manages a Rixl project, providing an isolated container for videos, images, and content feeds.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_project" "prod" {
  org_id        = var.rixl_org_id
  name          = "production-streaming"
  video_quality = "1080p"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `org_id` (String)

### Optional

- `regions` (List of String)
- `video_quality` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `custom_domain` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String)
